target.role: Principal, Total Portfolio Management Trading Desk

summary: Candidate for the Principal, Total Portfolio Management Trading Desk role with ~7 years across fixed-income and FX analytics, derivatives valuation and sensitivity validation, liability-driven portfolio construction, and macro-rates scenario analysis for Canadian and global institutional plans. Holds delegated sign-off on multi-asset institutional portfolios; designed a multi-scenario cash-flow projection engine; conducted VaR/CVaR optimization, risk management, and cross-asset risk decomposition at Ortec Finance. Python and SQL in daily production use; VBA in professional context (reading, maintaining, refactoring). CFA charterholder; dual MSc in Financial Modelling and Chemical Engineering.
core_skills: AI-Enabled Analytics Workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE)

roles.title: Asst. Director - Modelling Services (Investment & ALM Risk Lead)

sections.heading: Derivatives, Fixed Income & FX Analytics
bullets: Validates derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation — reviews sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level aggregates for multi-asset institutional mandates prior to production release.
Reviews yield-curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions; escalates outputs lacking economic defensibility to Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.
Analyzes interest-rate and duration exposure under parallel and non-parallel shocks, supporting liability-sensitive positioning across ALM horizons.

sections.heading: Portfolio Analytics, Liability Hedging & Stakeholder Reporting
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for institutional client portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative book).

Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios — provides forward-looking liquidity visibility to support liability-hedge sizing and funding decisions.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity-gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year), enabling funding optimization and asset-allocation decisions across public-markets exposures.
Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative outputs into investment-committee-ready narratives.

sections.heading: Python, SQL & AI-Enabled Tooling
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection — reduced development cycle time an estimated 30–40% on comparable pricing, validation, and reporting modules.

Led onboarding of U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consultants migrating to the PFaroe multi-asset platform — translated investment-desk requirements into development requests and validated post-deployment model outputs.
Migrated all assigned client accounts from legacy Calypso to PFaroe PM, advising on asset, liability, and ALM configurations.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management functions on milestone delivery, governance documentation, and regulatory-readiness materials.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform — with risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk analysis, and near-optimal frontier robustness testing to support allocation recommendations.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators to assess interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk under base and stressed macro regimes for Canadian and international pension funds.

Conducted liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis for pension-fund clients — quantified trade-offs between return targets, duration alignment, and liquidity; delivered SAA and TAA recommendations to investment committees.
Performed cash-flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across rates, inflation, and currency risk for international institutional clients; presented findings to investment committees on-site.

Led onboarding and the ALM study for the University Pension Plan (UPP) three-plan merger — on a team of three, modelled Funding Policy dynamics, duration, currency, inflation, and leverage-overlay strategies.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) — Western University, 2016
